one_line: An early Chalukya stone-carver working on the rock-cut sanctuaries at Badami in 6th–7th century Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean and wiry with craftsman’s muscles from constant hammer-and-chisel work.
appearance.face: Oval face with a medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, strong jaw, faint stubble, a few stone-dust scratches, and calm, focused eyes; default expression is concentrated yet quietly proud, as if mid-carving.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and pulled back into a small low knot at the back of the head, neatly smoothed at the sides, with a thin plain white cotton headband tied around the forehead to keep sweat from his eyes.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate artisan attire: a knee-length, unstitched off-white cotton dhoti wrapped securely with a forward pleat and tucked at the waist, dyed with a very faint earthy tint from stone dust; a short-sleeved, light beige cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over the torso and thrown over the left shoulder, practical rather than ornate; a simple narrow brown leather belt at the waist holding small tool pouches; bare lower arms with a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist; modest dark brown leather sandals with simple straps; minimal jewellery limited to small plain copper stud earrings to keep him humble yet distinct.
appearance.signature: A worn iron hammer and pointed chisel set: the hammer with a dark wooden handle and slightly mushroomed iron head, the chisel long and slender with a squared tip, both hanging from his belt when not held firmly in his hands.

ref_desc: A lean early Chalukya Badami cave artisan with medium-brown skin, oval face, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti and beige upper cloth with brown belt and sandals, always carrying an iron hammer and chisel in earthy off-white and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a single early Chalukya stone artisan from Badami: a lean young man with medium-brown Deccan skin, an oval face, calm but focused eyes, and a few light stone-dust scratches; his thick black hair is oiled and pulled into a small low knot at the back, framed by a thin plain white cotton headband across his forehead. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti wrapped with a forward pleat and tucked at the waist, slightly stained with faint stone-dust earthy tones, and a simple light beige cotton upper cloth wrapped diagonally across his torso and draped over his left shoulder. A narrow brown leather belt sits at his waist, with small tool pouches and loops, and he has modest dark brown leather sandals with straightforward straps; jewellery is minimal, just small copper stud earrings and a single thin copper bangle on his right wrist. Show his signature tools clearly: a worn iron hammer with a dark wooden handle and slightly flared head in one hand and a long pointed iron chisel in the other, with both also shown hanging from his belt in another pose. Use a restrained palette of off-white, light beige, earthy brown, dark brown, and black, and present him from front, side, and back angles so the same costume, hairstyle, and tools can be drawn consistently.
